# deps: tools: add gomvpkg

Add `gomvpkg` (`golang.org/x/tools/cmd/gomvpkg`) to the Go toolset. **Motivation:** refactoring — moving a Go package and rewriting all its importers in one step:

```bash
$  gomvpkg -from <path>  -to <path>
```
